title: Skilled Parenting
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Explain children’s development from conception through adolescence in the physical, social, emotional, and cognitive domains.
Identify community resources to support children and their families that facilitates early intervention and/or offers supportive and rehabilitative services.
Explain socialization of the child focusing on the interrelationship of family, culture, teachers, and the community.
